authorized_audience: requester and Julia, both project developers
purpose: Review every aggregate percentage and count in Attrition V7, including buckets below the shared-output threshold, before deciding whether any variable should be used for attrition.

scope.aggregate_buckets: show every available category, count and percentage; do not suppress solely because n is below 30

small_cell_exception.reason: Explicit internal exploratory request for two named project developers; the audience can review aggregate percentages without employee-level detail.

interpretation: The exception changes only aggregate display suppression for this internal V7 artifact. It does not impute unavailable metrics, create employee-level records, change attrition definitions, or make a non-estimable rate estimable.
